title: Planned Gopher adapter: bounded SSC capabilities, not arbitrary osc execution
summary: Gopher needs a dedicated SSC service adapter with fixed schemas and parsed machine output. Do not expose arbitrary shell/osc flags. SSC should add a stable JSON protocol so the adapter does not scrape human text.
invariants: Read-only negative outcomes such as NOT_FOUND/UNCHANGED/REVIEW_REQUIRED return tool_status OK; they must not trigger Gopher service fallback.
Mutations require stale fences: expected repository generation/parent level/candidate digest/proposal digest as applicable.
Result pages are resumable UI projections; durable history remains in SSC.
